_comment: PyBullet twin timed like e-puck #2473 over Bluetooth: 5 Hz control loop and ~85 ms between reading the sensors and the new wheel command taking effect. Motion and IR knobs stay at their defaults: they correct the real robot towards the model, which the twin already is. max_speed 0.08 as in the real profile (at 5 Hz full speed reacts too late: 2-7% of steps touching obstacles in the twin, ~0-1% at 0.08).
